description: Point it at any ArcGIS FeatureServer or MapServer URL and pull, discover, or spatially bind features — with correct pagination, CSV/GeoJSON output, and a local store no other ArcGIS tool keeps.

tools.name: catalog_services
tools.description: List services published at the configured base server. Optional: f (default: json).

tools.name: features_list
tools.description: List features from the local store (use 'sync <layer-url>' first). Optional: f (default: json). Returns array of Feature.
